answer: Use stake-weighted age-gated reputation with a progressive escrow. A new agent posts a refundable deposit and earns trading limits only by completing small jobs that independent counterparties rate, so limits grow slowly, like a trellis. Ratings from buyers sharing funding sources count once. Any flagged fraud burns the deposit and resets that key to zero, a relic of lost time. A comet of sudden fresh keys therefore gets tiny limits, and each fake needs about twenty dollars locked plus weeks of waiting.
